fancybars.bars.config.explanation:
Welcome to the status bars config screen!

Drag and drop the bars to snap them to an anchor (white squares), existing bars or you can put them anywhere.
You can right click them to edit a bunch of properties.
By hovering your mouse between 2 bars (your cursor should change), you can resize them.

Everything is saved when you leave.

Use the ☰ button (or Esc) to go back to the ShikiClient menu.
fancybars.bars.config.reset:
This will reset the status bars to their default positions.
This cannot be undone.
fancybars.bars.description: Show or hide bars and their icons, and pick their colours.
fancybars.config.actionBarBackground.@To: Draw a rounded background behind the action bar.
fancybars.config.actionBarColor.@Tooltip: The colour used when Custom Text Colour is on.
fancybars.config.actionBarCustomize.@Too: Draw the action bar with ShikiClient' renderer so the options below apply. Off = vanilla look (still movable).
fancybars.config.actionBarFade.@Tooltip: Fade the action bar out when it stops updating, like vanilla.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideDefense.@T: Remove the defense part (❈) from the action bar.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideHealth.@To: Remove the health part (❤) from the action bar, even when the health bar is off.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideMana.@Tool: Remove the mana part (✎) from the action bar.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideRiftTime.@: Remove the time left (ф) from the action bar in the Rift.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideSkillXp.@T: Remove "+12 Combat (1,234/5,000)" style skill XP messages.
fancybars.config.actionBarHideVitality.@: Remove the vitality part from the action bar in the Rift.
fancybars.config.actionBarShadow.@Toolti: Draw a shadow behind the text.
fancybars.config.actionBarShown.@Tooltip: Show the action bar at all. Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.actionBarSmoothFont.@To: Use the smooth bold font instead of the pixel font.
fancybars.config.actionBarUseCustomColor: Draw all action bar text in one colour instead of Hypixel's colours.
Hover a backpack or ender chest page in the Storage menu (/storage) to see what's inside. Each one is remembered after you open it once.
fancybars.config.backpackPreviewNeedsShi: Only show the preview while Shift is held. When off, hold Shift to see the normal tooltip instead.
fancybars.config.enableBars.@Tooltip: Enables the fancy Health, Mana, Defense, Vitality, Speed, and XP Bars.
fancybars.config.enableBarsRift.@Tooltip: Also show the fancy bars while in the Rift.
fancybars.config.enableVanillaStyleManaB: Shows mana as a row of vanilla-style icons in place of the hunger bar. Only used when the fancy bars are disabled.
Enable Vanilla Style Mana Bar Blinking
Makes the vanilla-style mana bar blink when you use mana.
fancybars.config.gifsEnabled.@Tooltip: Show your animated GIFs in the player inventory. Open your inventory and click the GIFs button to move, resize and fade them.
fancybars.config.gifsHideCraftingGrid.@T: Hide the 2x2 crafting grid in the inventory to make room for GIFs.
fancybars.config.gifsHideRecipeBook.@Too: Hide the recipe book button in the inventory (only while the crafting grid is hidden).
fancybars.config.heldItemNameEnabled.@To: Turn off to hide the item name that appears when you switch items.
fancybars.config.hideMana: Hide Mana Consumption Messages from Action Bar
fancybars.config.hideMana.@Tooltip: Gives a better experience when using Fancy Status Bars.
fancybars.config.intelligenceDisplay.@To:
Original: overflow mana is drawn over the mana bar.
Accurate: the bar is split between mana and overflow mana.
Smallest In Front: whichever is smaller is drawn on top.
fancybars.config.intelligenceDisplay.sho: How overflow mana is drawn on the mana bar.
fancybars.config.itemProtectionEnabled.@: Block dropping, selling, salvaging, trading and auctioning protected items.
fancybars.config.protectionChatNotificat: Show a chat message when you protect or unprotect an item.
fancybars.config.rareDropsBackground.@To: Draw a rounded background behind the tracker.
fancybars.config.rareDropsChat.@Tooltip: Send a chat message with the drop count and runs since your last rare drop.
fancybars.config.rareDropsEnabled.@Toolt: Count rare dungeon chest drops and the runs between them.
fancybars.config.rareDropsHud.@Tooltip: Show your rare drop counts on screen while you're in the Dungeon Hub. Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP: Rift Health: HP instead of hearts
fancybars.config.riftHealthHP.@Tooltip: In the rift, if enabled, the health status bar will display HP (20, 19, 18, ...) instead of Hearts (10, 9.5, 9, ...)
fancybars.config.secretsEnabled.@Tooltip: Show how many secrets you've found in the current dungeon room (from the action bar). Move and scale it in the editor.
fancybars.config.secretsHideActionBar.@T: Remove the "X/Y Secrets" text from the action bar while the display is on.
fancybars.config.secretsShowChest.@Toolt: Show the chest icon next to the secrets count.
fancybars.config.secretsShowWord.@Toolti: Show the word Secrets above the count. Turn off for just the numbers.
fancybars.config.showEstimatedTilde.@Too: Displays a tilde (~) before a bar's value when it is estimated by FancyBars because it is not visible in the action bar.
fancybars.config.smoothBarText.@Tooltip: Draw the numbers on the bars with the smooth Inter font instead of the pixel font.
fancybars.config.title: ShikiClient Settings
fancybars.config.useHungerBarSprites.@To: Uses the vanilla hunger icons for the vanilla-style mana bar.

fancybars.protection.howTo: Press %s while holding an item, or while hovering it in your inventory or storage, to protect or unprotect it. /shikiclient protect also works. Change the key in Options › Controls › ShikiClient.
